Buy from **Seller A — Brackmoor Sound** — `https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/6vzk5j/a`

* **Rating:** 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)
* **Shipping:** Free standard, 3-5 business days

> **"Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty."**

Seller B — Ottervale Audio — makes no such claim.

Since you're paying the same price with the same shipping and return terms, there's no downside to A, and authorized-dealer status reduces the risks with B — of getting counterfeit/grey-market stock, or having the manufacturer refuse the warranty.
